notes: Where the Trend Scout may search (docs/AGENTS.md, section 4). It searches only the sites in 'only': Indian fashion magazines and the lifestyle pages of national news sites, chosen for the owner to review. 'blocked' is a second guard: shops, marketplaces, and social networks are never read, even if one appears on 'only' by mistake. Read by the Trend Scout's code, never loaded into reference tables. Use bare domains, without www.
